description: Zhou Cang, burly chinese fighter in the supplied pixel art style. A brown cloth head wrap with a tail, olive sleeves under tan lamellar armor, a brown sash, dark trousers and boots. He holds a broad curved saber in the right hand
face: A big bushy black beard and heavy brows.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the brown head wrap with its tail, tan armor over olive sleeves, the curved saber at his right side.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the sword up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the sword, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: One level horizontal cut. Frames 1-5 the sword is taken far out to the right at chest height; frame 8 it cuts across level to the left; frames 9-11 follow through on the left. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The broad curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: One rising cut from low to high. Frames 1-5 lower the sword and coil; frame 8 the upward cut lands; frames 9-11 the sword finishes high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The broad curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch and raise the sword; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground; frame 8 he lands cutting straight down; frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The broad curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s5: Standing guard. Frames 1-6 he steps to plant himself and brings the sword across in front as a barrier; frame 8 he braces low and firm; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The broad curved saber stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c6: Spinning cut. The body winds to the right with the sword drawn back, then makes one full turn on the spot with the sword held out level, and the blade comes round onto the target; a short hold facing forward.
actions.b2: Thrust, then rising cut. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a straight thrust; frames 7-8 the sword drops low; frame 9 a rising cut; frames 10-11 the sword finishes high.
actions.c2: Block, then a backhand cut. Frames 3-6 the sword is held across in front of the body as a block and the knees sink; frame 7 the sword swings to the LEFT hip; frame 8 a step forward and a backhand cut from left to right; frames 9-12 hold on the right.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s5. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
